definitions.gloss: blush; rouge (cosmetic applied to the cheeks to add color)
definitions.explanation: A cosmetic in powder, cream, or liquid form applied to the cheeks to give them a healthy, rosy color. The native Japanese term, slightly more old-fashioned than the loanword チーク.

examples.japanese: {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
{頬紅|ほほべに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed my blush to a spring-like pink color.

examples.japanese: {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{顔色|かおいろ}→顔色：25468_kaoiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Wearing blush makes my complexion look brighter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、⟦{口紅|くちべに}→口紅：00249_kuchibeni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{頬紅|ほほべに}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧なお⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: My grandmother says that when she was young, she wore simple makeup — just lipstick and blush.

notes:
{頬紅|ほほべに} combines ⟦{頬|ほほ}→頬：00110_hoho⟧ (cheek) and ⟦{紅|べに}→紅：13862_beni⟧ (rouge, red). It is a native Japanese term for blush makeup, somewhat traditional in feel; younger speakers and modern cosmetic packaging more often use the loanword チーク (from "cheek").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply blush
- {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on blush
- {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぼかす: to blend blush
- {頬紅|ほほべに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: the color of one's blush

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チーク / チーク⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧: blush (modern loanword, by far more common in marketing and casual speech)
- ⟦{口紅|くちべに}→口紅：00249_kuchibeni⟧: lipstick (uses the same ⟦{紅|べに}→紅：13862_beni⟧ morpheme)
- ほお{紅|べに} (alt. spelling): same word, with ほお written in hiragana — common in cosmetic ads aimed at older customers
- アイシャドウ: eyeshadow
- ⟦ファンデーション→ファンデーション：08799_fandeeshon⟧: foundation

USAGE:
- The reading ほほべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ and ほおべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ are both used; modern dictionaries list ほおべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as the more common standard, but ほほべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is also widely accepted, especially in older or literary contexts.
- In cosmetics product names, the form チーク is dominant in Japan — {頬紅|ほほべに} is more often found in articles, novels, or by older speakers.
